items.title: Plans go in for up to nine more homes on agricultural land on village outskirts
items.content: Plans have been submitted for up to nine homes on farmland behind eight approved houses in Warboys. The application seeks permission in principle for between six and nine homes on 0.85 hectares north of Heath Road, on the village’s north-eastern edge. If approved, the two schemes could provide up to 17 homes on this stretch of Heath Road. S Robinson submitted the latest proposal, with David Mead of The Planning Partnership as planning agent, and Huntingdonshire District Council granted permission for the eight-home development on October 20. A diagram showing the proposed layout of the development. (Image: HDC) Permission in principle would let the council decide whether the site, its residential use and the scale of development are acceptable. items.title: 5 Huntingdonshire planning applications that you should know about
items.content: Planning committees across Huntingdonshire are busy as ever, with plenty of applications and appeals coming through. We've compiled a list of just some of the applications that are currently pending or have been approved in our areas. Here are some that might have gone under the radar. The application, reference 26/01646/FUL, seeks permission to change the use of land on the south side of Middle Drove, Ramsey Heights, to accommodate four static caravans for residential use. The proposals also include parking for vehicles, space for two touring caravans and the construction of a brick and tile utility and day room for residents. Existing hardstanding at the site would be retained. A statement accompanying the plans says: "Mr Reilly and his family are looking for a settled environment with a permanent base to call home." items.title: New eight-home development in Warboys approved despite resident objections
items.content: Plans for a new eight-home development in Warboys have been approved despite objections from residents and the parish council. The proposal, from applicants Mr and Mrs Robinson, involves constructing eight detached homes on land between Heath Farm and Heath Pond, north of Heath Road in Warboys. The land is currently classed as agricultural. Plans include three three-bedroom and five four-bedroom homes, 16 parking spaces, landscaping and a footpath linking the site to the village. It was granted Permission in Principle in July 2025 for between four and nine homes, establishing that the site could be developed for housing. The plans include three-bedroom and four-bedroom homes, 16 parking spaces and landscaping (Image: Huntingdonshire Planning Portal) Despite the formal submission of these plans, the proposal has faced objections from Warboys Parish Council and residents.
